description: 5 steps framework to get yourself out of any negative self-talk. Use it because no one is judging yourself as harsh as you do.
transcript: What the fuck is wrong with me? Why it's not working? I had a thought that something is wrong with me. What is the message? The message is that I'm not meeting my own standards. What should I believe in order to seem that way? I believe that by spending so much time on it, I should already have the results. Is this a fair expectation? Probably not. I'm too strict on myself. So what should I do with that? I should review my expectations and I should put more focus on the right things to do. Changing your life is not happening overnight. So follow me and let's do this together.
